changelog:
Initial release of cis-openeuler-audit.

- Provides OpenEuler CIS Benchmark compliance auditing with automated report generation.
- Matches OpenEuler version to the corresponding RHEL CIS Benchmark using a version matrix.
- Collects system baseline via script and analyzes compliance differences with mapping tables.
- Outputs Markdown-format audit reports without modifying the target system.
- Supports manual, scheduled (cron), and CI/CD-triggered audits.
- Emphasizes script-driven workflow, external configuration, and secure handling of sensitive data.
summary: 审计 OpenEuler 系统与对应 RHEL CIS Benchmark 的合规差异，生成合规报告。
